interpretation: Target must match document, heading, source revision and exact text hash; a heading-only hit is insufficient.
If the target is absent from lexical18 while all 18 corpus records are verified, investigate lexical candidate generation; do not assume reranking can add candidates.
If lexical contains the target but semantic moves it below five, record a ranking effect, subject to successful non-partial semantic response.
If kb18 finds the target but kb5 does not, record an output-window effect; differing calls do not alone prove implementation causality.
If direct semantic and knowledge-base differ, record the boundary discrepancy and inspect activity; these are not guaranteed identical request contracts.
Manual-query success is a diagnostic control only; it changes query intent and uses source knowledge.
If configuration or corpus changes, mark comparison invalid; if authentication fails, stop without retry.
